description: This file defines the EquationInputArea class, a partial class for a XAML-based UI component in a calculator application. It manages a collection of equations and variables, handles UI interactions such as focusing on equations, adding/removing equations, color management, and accessibility features. It also raises events for external handling of key features and formatting requests.

classes.name: EquationInputArea
classes.description: A partial class representing the input area for equations in the graphing calculator UI, handling user interactions, color management, accessibility, and event raising.

methods.name: RaisePropertyChanged
methods.description: Raises the PropertyChanged event for data binding updates.

methods.name: OnPropertyChanged
methods.description: Handles property change notifications and triggers related updates.

methods.name: AddNewEquation
methods.description: Adds a new equation to the collection, assigning colors and focusing as needed.

methods.name: ReloadAvailableColors
methods.description: Reloads the color palette based on high contrast mode and theme matching.

methods.name: OnHighContrastChanged
methods.description: Event handler for changes in high contrast accessibility settings.

methods.name: OnColorValuesChanged
methods.description: Updates color palette when system color values change.

methods.name: GetViewModelFromEquationTextBox
methods.description: Retrieves the EquationViewModel associated with a given EquationTextBox control.

methods.name: FocusEquationTextBox
methods.description: Sets focus to a specific equation's text box.

methods.name: SubmitTextbox
methods.description: Validates and updates variable values from textbox input.

methods.name: ToggleVariableArea
methods.description: Toggles the visibility of variable sliders for a given variable.
